name: My Life Is Murder
description: Investigator Alexa Crowe, cannot help fighting the good fight – whether it is solving murders or combatting the small frustrations of everyday life. Fearless and unapologetic, Alexa's unique skills and insights into the darker quirks of human nature, allows her to provoke, comfort and push the right buttons as she unravels the truth behind the most baffling of crimes.

videos.title: The Boyfriend Experience
videos.overview: Former detective Alexa Crowe is lured into the world of murder and mystery when her friend and colleague asks her to look into the death of a woman who fell from the balcony of a male escort.

videos.title: The Locked Room
videos.overview: A man is found shot dead in a motel room. The door has been chain-locked from the inside. Someone killed him and escaped when the door was locked from the inside.

videos.title: Lividity in Lycra
videos.overview: Cycling groups are the ultimate opportunity for networking and power broking. But when the CFO of a hospitality empire dies on his morning ride, Alexa must infiltrate the world of lycra and butt pads.

videos.title: Can't Stand the Heat
videos.overview: Alexa is thrown into the world of culinary excellence while investigating the death of a cooking school student. Alexa must hone her chops to uncover a tangled web of lies, rivalry and secrets.

videos.title: Feet of Clay
videos.overview: Alexa investigates the hit and run death of a young woman. Although the drunk driver involved turned herself in, Alexa believes the accident may be the work of an opportunistic killer.

videos.title: Another Bloody Podcast
videos.overview: Alexa investigates a case that runs the gamut of birth, marriage and murder when a young man is found dead in an alley after a fight at his brothers wedding.

videos.title: Old School
videos.overview: Alexa's past catches up to her as she returns to her exclusive, private high school to investigate the mysterious death of her much beloved former teacher.

videos.title: Remains to Be Seen
videos.overview: After a near-death experience, Alexa is confronted by her own mortality as she explores the „Big Death” industry to unravel the secrets of a murdered man whose body was found in someone elses grave.

videos.title: Fake Empire
videos.overview: When a clairvoyant contacts the police about a murder, offering details that have never been released to the public, Alexa jumps at the opportunity to prove that clairvoyants are frauds.

videos.title: Mirror Mirror
videos.overview: When a cosmetic surgeon dies after self-administering an anti-wrinkle drug, Alexa immerses herself the world of the beautiful and the vain to uncover what really happened to the bright young doctor.

videos.title: Call of the Wild
videos.overview: When a woman shoots a stranger at point blank range by Auckland Harbour, it looks like an open-and-shut case. But investigator Alexa Crowe discovers not everything is as it seems.

videos.title: Oceans Apart
videos.overview: Alexa's investigation into the death of a surfing champion takes her back to an old childhood haunt. But what is the victim's influencer girlfriend trying to hide? And why is Alexa so reluctant to spend time at one of the world's best beaches?

videos.title: All That Glitters
videos.overview: Alexa's personal and professional lives collide when she investigates the death of a drag queen whose career was on the rise.

videos.title: Look Don't Touch
videos.overview: Alexa is confronted by her own history when she investigates the death of a museum curator.

videos.title: Crushed Dreams
videos.overview: Alexa will need all five senses to solve the mysterious death of an ambitious young winemaker.

videos.title: Sleep No More
videos.overview: A frosty reception awaits Alexa when she investigates how the chef at a resort died in his own walk-in freezer.

videos.title: All The Better To See You
videos.overview: All the worlds a stage when Alexa investigates a murder of an actor in the middle of a live performance.

videos.title: Hidden Gems
videos.overview: Alexa must sort fact from fiction when a compulsive liar confesses to a murder at a high-end jeweler.

videos.title: Wild Life
videos.overview: Harry asks Alexa to look into the case of his friend accused of murdering a survival expert.

videos.title: Pleasure and Pain
videos.overview: Alexa investigates the death of a self-help guru and ends up in a cat-and-mouse game with the victim's mysterious wife.

videos.title: It Takes Two
videos.overview: When Alexa investigates the death of a young teacher at a tango club, it's not clear who is leading whom in a dangerous dance to discover the truth.

videos.title: Nothing Concrete
videos.overview: Truth is stranger than fiction when a crime novelist is found dead, encased in a public sculpture. Alexa uncovers a plot more deadly than any of the victim's novels.

videos.title: Bloodlines
videos.overview: Alexa is determined to prove the innocence of a champion thoroughbred blamed for the death of his handler at a successful horse breeding stud, where secrets lurk and blood is thicker than water.

videos.title: The Village
videos.overview: Alexa investigates a death at an upscale retirement village where a quiet life is the last thing residents want, and where her brother's involvement with the victims feels too close to home.

videos.title: Silent Lights
videos.overview: When Christmas lights aficionado Paddy falls from his roof, Alexa finds herself untangling a mystery as tangled as Paddy's beloved lights.

videos.title: Bride To Bee
videos.overview: When a bride dies from an allergic reaction to a bee sting on her wedding day, Alexa must discover whether this is just a tragic accident... or a case where revenge is as sweet as honey.

videos.title: Breaking Bread
videos.overview: Feuding celebrity bakers put Alexa through her paces when a man is found drowned with a rare flour in his lungs.

videos.title: Gaslight Sonata
videos.overview: Alexa and Madison's investigation into the death of a music producer is complicated by the arrival of a young girl at Alexa's door with some very big news.

videos.title: Staying Mum
videos.overview: When Alexa investigates the death of a popular male nanny, she discovers some pushy parents are more terrifying than most killers she has met before.

videos.title: Rising Angel
videos.overview: Alexa investigates a young model’s death backstage at a fashion show.

videos.title: To Dye For
videos.overview: A wealthy socialite dies in suspicious circumstances, leaving her entire fortune to her cat. To uncover the truth, Alexa investigates a heady world of high society gossip.

videos.title: Tough Love
videos.overview: Alexa’s investigates the death of a tough tennis coach, but she’s not the only one on the case. A glamorous private investigator is determined to solve the case before Alexa.

videos.title: Location, Location, Location
videos.overview: A real estate agent is found dead at an open home, and Alexa’s investigation takes a supernatural turn when the homeowner insists the 100 year old house is cursed.

videos.title: One Man’s Poison
videos.overview: Alexa investigates ‘death by stir-fry’ when Reuben is desperate for her to clear the name of his friend, a private chef accused of poisoning one of this clients.

videos.title: En Pointe
videos.overview: A ballerina has been shot dead with a bow and arrow at a prestigious ballet academy. While Madison tries her hand at archery, Alexa poses as a dance mom to uncover the terrible truth.

videos.title: The Good Oil
videos.overview: Alexa ignores her own family problems to find justice for grieving Samoan matriarch Eme, whose son Ropati was shot dead at a botched robbery at his coconut oil factory.

videos.title: The Widow’s Club (1)
videos.overview: Alexa and her brother Will infiltrate an exclusive country club, where a group of wealthy golf widows have the men running scared.

videos.title: The Widow’s Club (2)
videos.overview: Alexa is on the wrong side of a murder investigation, fighting to clear her own name while avoiding the webs of the three Black Widows.

videos.title: Gimme An M
videos.overview: After a fitness influencer live streams his own murder, Alexa enters the world of professional cheerleading to find out - is murder a team sport?

videos.title: Catfish
videos.overview: Death by deadly jellyfish leads Alexa to a popular aquarium on Auckland's waterfront, where she meets a handsome marine biologist, a scheming mermaid, and a watchful octopus.

videos.title: For the Love of Dog
videos.overview: A custody battle over a cherished dog has ended in murder. Alexa’s investigation is complicated by the antics of her brother Will Crowe, who is tempted to return to his conman past.

videos.title: Top Two Inches
videos.overview: In a world full of bitter rivals and bad winners at an exclusive Pub Quiz Night, Alexa and Madison have just one night to catch a killer before all the suspects scatter forever.

videos.title: Thirteen O’Clock
videos.overview: A falling concrete gargoyle kills a man at a party, and the lead suspect is a deadly talking doll. Trapped in an escape room with a killer, Alexa finds that murder is not child’s play.

videos.title: Bad Chemistry
videos.overview: Alexa seeks justice for a promising young chemistry student who died after a baffling accident in the laboratory, and finds that everyone has a secret... including her friend Detective Harry Henare.

videos.title: The One That Got Away (1)
videos.overview: On a holiday in tropical Fiji, Alexa comes face to face with an old foe. But catching this killer isn’t Alexa’s only unfinished business, as she joins forces with her former police partner Jesse.

videos.title: The One That Got Away (2)
videos.overview: Murder and mayhem continue in the Pacific Island paradise where Alexa starts to close in on a killer with a body count, but will her head be turned by a romantic prospect - or two?
